Test Case: Product list is shown after login
Steps: 1) Log in as standard_user 2) Look at the Products page
Expected Result: 6 products are shown, each with image, name, price and Add to cart button

Test Case: Sort products by price low to high
Steps: 1) Log in as standard_user 2) Open the sort dropdown 3) Select Price (low to high)
Expected Result: Products are shown from lowest to highest price

Test Case: Sort products by name Z to A
Steps: 1) Log in as standard_user 2) Open the sort dropdown 3) Select Name (Z to A)
Expected Result: Products are shown in reverse alphabetical order

Steps: 1) Log in as standard_user 2) Click any product name 3) Click Back to products
Expected Result: Details page shows the same name, price and description; Back to products returns to the list

Steps: 1) Log in as standard_user 2) Click Add to cart on one product
Expected Result: Button changes to Remove and cart icon shows 1

Steps: 1) Log in as standard_user 2) Click Add to cart on three different products
Expected Result: Cart icon shows 3

Steps: 1) Add one product to cart 2) Click Remove on the same product
Expected Result: Button changes back to Add to cart and cart count goes down by 1

Steps: 1) Add two products to cart 2) Click the cart icon
Expected Result: Cart page shows both products with correct name, price and quantity 1

Steps: 1) Add two products to cart 2) Open cart 3) Click Remove on one product
Expected Result: That product is removed and cart icon shows 1

Steps: 1) Add one product to cart 2) Open cart and click Checkout 3) Enter First Name, Last Name and Postal Code 4) Click Continue
Expected Result: Checkout Overview page opens and shows the product and price details

Steps: 1) Add one product to cart 2) Open cart and click Checkout 3) Leave First Name empty and fill the other fields 4) Click Continue
Expected Result: Error shown: First Name is required

Steps: 1) Add one product to cart 2) Open cart and click Checkout 3) Fill First Name and Last Name, leave Postal Code empty 4) Click Continue
Expected Result: Error shown: Postal Code is required

Steps: 1) Add two products to cart 2) Go to Checkout Overview page 3) Check Item total, Tax and Total
Expected Result: Item total equals the sum of product prices, and Total equals Item total plus Tax

Steps: 1) Go to Checkout Overview page 2) Click Finish
Expected Result: Thank you for your order! message is shown and the cart becomes empty
